# Overall ranking

```{r}
AHR_data_2022 %>% 
  filter(state != "United States") %>% 
  select(state, overall_score_rank) %>% arrange(overall_score_rank) %>% 
  datatable()

```

```{r}
states_map <- st_as_sf(map("state", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))

d_map <- AHR_data_2022 %>% 
  filter(state != "United States") %>% 
  select(state, contains("rank")) %>% 
mutate(state = str_to_lower(state)) %>% left_join(states_map, by = c("state" = "ID"))  
d_map <- st_as_sf(d_map)

create_maps(d_map, c("overall_score_rank"))
```

# Comparing 2021 - 2022

## Changes between 2021 - 2022

All values of 2021 minus all values of 2022.

```{r}


allranks_22 <- AHR_data_2022 %>% select(state, contains("rank")) %>% arrange(state)
allranks_21 <- AHR_data_2021 %>% select(state, contains("rank")) %>% 
  select(-rank_26th_report) %>% 
  rename(state_avg_congestion_hours_rank = state_avg_delay_hours_rank) %>% 
  arrange(state)

change <- allranks_22[,-1] - allranks_21[,-1]

# adding state name back 
change_2021_2022 <- cbind(state = AHR_data_2022[, "state"], change) %>% 
   mutate_if(is.numeric, ~round(., 2))

change_2021_2022 %>% write.csv("output/change_2021_2022.csv")

datatable(change_2021_2022)

```

## Change in overall ranking

```{r}

change_2021_2022 %>% select(state, overall_score_rank) %>% arrange(overall_score_rank) %>% 
  filter(state != "United States") %>% 
  mutate(group = case_when(overall_score_rank > 0 ~ "up",
                           overall_score_rank == 0 ~ "no change",
                           overall_score_rank < 0 ~ "down",
                           )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fct_reorder(state, overall_score_rank), overall_score_rank,
             text = paste("State:", state, "<br>Rank Change:", overall_score_rank, "<br>Group:", group))) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = group)) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#76A5AF", "#DFCDB4", "#C25B56")) +
  labs(title = "Change in overall ranking 2021 - 2022\n",
       x = "") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) -> p_change

ggplotly(p_change, tooltip = "text")
```
